sections.title: Raw source
items: Summary: A module-facing tracker for how a creature, NPC group, or faction leaves a scene: helped, calmed, fought, captured, spared, or harmed.
When: Use for Strixwolf and Bramble-style outcomes that should ripple later.
Not When: Do not turn it into a mandatory plot lock; it records consequence, not a required solution.
Answer: Track what the table actually did and how the affected side now feels about them.
Example: The Strixwolf instance records whether the party calmed, fed, fought, or frightened the mother; the Bramble instance records parley, mercy, violence, or capture.
Aliases: strixwolf mercy track bramble resolution track disposition
Source: Official SRD / local quickstart reference. Use private full-rulebook material only at the table.
